scripts.setup: yarn --cwd server install && yarn --cwd web install && yarn --cwd agent install && yarn --cwd server db:deploy && yarn --cwd web build
scripts.start: yarn --cwd web build && yarn --cwd server start
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "yarn --cwd server dev" "yarn --cwd web dev"
scripts.typecheck: yarn --cwd server typecheck && yarn --cwd agent typecheck && yarn --cwd web build
scripts.ip: ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1
